text: I just got the job offer I've been waiting months for!
This makes me so happy I could cry.
I can't stop thinking about how much I miss them.
Everything feels heavy and grey today.
I feel completely drained and empty.
I'm furious with them for lying to my face.
Why would they even say that to me, that's so unfair.
I'm a little nervous about the interview tomorrow.
I'm terrified of what might happen.
She made me feel so loved and grateful.
Just a normal, quiet evening at home.
